faq.q: What is the origin of Timur?
faq.a: Timur is associated with Turkish. Timur is Turkic, meaning 'iron'. It was borne by the conqueror Timur (Tamerlane).
No — the underlying form is Turkish, not Arabic.
Timur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkish-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: In Persian, Timur is rendered تیمور and carries the sense تیمور، آهن.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Timur, timur. Script forms are تيمور, تِيمُور, تیمور, तैमूर.

faq.q: Is Timur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
